digest.component_or_area: capability enforcement and optional dependency management
propositions: A registry-based semantic capability system must enforce that each capability maps to exactly one declared packaging extra and one missing posture (error/unavailable/abstain/fallback) without importing probe modules.
Stable CLI commands and top-level help must remain accessible in no-extras wheels; only selected execution boundaries emit errors for error-posture capabilities after mode/backend selection.
Lean diagnostic and read-only modes (audit show, non-agent review workflows, unselected providers) must execute without requiring sibling live-mode capabilities.

Domain components for unavailable/abstain/fallback capabilities retain full control of result payloads, exceptions, and logging; the registry provides metadata only and never manufactures domain results.
Separate entrypoints (rebar-mcp, review-bot) must be discoverable as capabilities and reusable without appearing in the top-level CLI route registry.
